name: Green River (Labyrinth Canyon)
gaugeName: Green River at Green River, UT
blurb: Flatwater canoe/raft trip from the town of Green River through Labyrinth Canyon to Mineral Bottom. BLM permit required (downloaded and emailed to BLM).

sections.putIn: Green River State Park Boat Ramp
sections.notes: BLM: minimum 3-4 days for the 68 river-miles; BLM permit required (downloaded and emailed to BLM; none submitted by this package; fee not stated). Mineral Bottom road: high clearance/4WD recommended, impassable when wet, steep switchbacks. Ruby Ranch alternative launch is private (fee).

guideTimes.conditions: BLM recommends a minimum planning allowance of three to four days for the 68-mile trip. This is a trip itinerary; allow longer as conditions require.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
